questions: Does the generated PortalStore.begin implementation call the ten repository create_*_schema capabilities, or does backend lowering perform equivalent schema work without those module calls?

quotes:
The portal's database connections (a new one per transaction) and its transactions: open, commit,
rollback and close, schema creation through the repositories, the
`PortalTransaction` that hands out one repository per port, and translation of
every storage failure to `PersistenceError` without SQL or driver detail;
`PortalTransaction` is the `AuditRepositoryContext` of the repositories it
hands out.

These
   calls are not a step a route or a note obliges: the sqlite unit-of-work
   backend lowers `PortalStore.begin` with them
   (`rules.sqlite_unit_of_work_backend`, schema `create_on_begin_in_accessor_order`),
   so no generated module calls them.
judgement.divergence: PortalStore.begin calls the ten repository-owned create_*_schema capabilities, or backend lowering performs equivalent schema creation without any generated module calling those capabilities; a repository-capability verification test or maintainer tracing PortalStore.begin observes the difference.
judgement.why: State 3 assigns PortalStore schema creation through the repositories, while State 4 says backend lowering performs it so no generated module calls those repository capabilities.

witness.initial: The service has a SQLite database missing one or more repository tables.
events: A monitor asks the running service for readiness.
PortalStore.begin ensures the missing schemas before returning the transaction.
outcomes: PortalStore.begin invokes the ten repository create_*_schema capabilities in accessor order.
Backend lowering performs the schema work without any generated module invoking the repository create_*_schema capabilities.
witness.observer: A repository-capability verification test or a maintainer tracing PortalStore.begin.
basis:
Readiness opens one
   `module:portal_store` transaction and rolls it back; it changes no product
   state.

Every `module:portal_store` transaction — readiness and every use case —
   begins by creating any missing table on its new connection, one schema
   function per repository in accessor order: `create_audit_schema`,
   `create_project_tracking_schema`, `create_project_section_schema`,
   `create_budget_schema`, `create_snapshot_import_schema`,
   `create_expense_schema`, `create_progress_photo_schema`,
   `create_staff_access_schema`, `create_client_access_schema` and
   `create_producer_identity_schema` (accepted note `PortalStore.begin`).
